text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the exhibition race.<n>Shinko Windy
has endured all manner<n>of harsh training in the
hopes of<n>performing well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things don't go as planned, however,<n>and she
finds herself in danger of<n>losing. Consumed by
thoughts of<n>failure, she impulsively bites the racer<n>in
front of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the racer isn't seriously<n>injured, but
news of the incident<n>spreads across Japan like
wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some deep self-reflection,<n>Shinko Windy
apologizes to the racer<n>and promises to never bite
anyone<n>during a race again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next objective is the Unicorn<n>Stakes. She
decides that it's time to<n>reset her spirits and direct
her efforts<n>there.
